summary: Disaster Desk long video not made: check-plan refuses the only long topic (Hyatt Regency walkways) because it names no winning Short, and this long-first channel has none. I added 16 sourced facts and a 7-chapter outline from the NBS report to the topic so the next run can script it at once.
why: generator/topics.py winning_short() requires `from_short` (a Short with 100+ views in the top third by stayed to watch); the channel's only Short (v-20261121-42, Lac-Mégantic) has 0 views and a different subject; the new-channel exemption ended when it published on 21 Nov. Studio never changes code (agents/policy.md).

findings.title: from_short gate blocks long-first channels
findings.detail: check-plan: feed topic '2026-11-20-hyatt-walkways' can't be used: names no `from_short`. Every long topic on this channel will fail the same way until the rule exempts long-first channels.

findings.title: NBS report read for the Hyatt topic
